major_cooldowns.name: Takedown
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it with a Tip of the Spear stack to spend, or at 0 stacks when you run Twin Fangs so it generates three.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1250646 is both the cast and the self buff in the sampled parses; 1253859, 1253862 and 1258571 share the name and are talent nodes.

major_cooldowns.name: Boomstick
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it with a Tip of the Spear stack up, and hold it for adds that are about to spawn since its cone hits everything in front of you.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base_cd_s is 60; the guide states it is functionally a 45 second cooldown in single target and as low as 15 seconds in AoE with Lethal Calibration. 1261215 shares the name and was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Moonlight Chakram
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Throw it with a Tip of the Spear stack inside the window Takedown opens, once you have room for the 10 second Wildfire Bomb cooldown reduction from Stalk and Strike.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Sentinel talent; cast id observed in 3/5 parses. It carries no cooldown of its own and replaces Takedown for 15 sec after Takedown is cast, so the listed cooldown mirrors Takedown's.

major_cooldowns.name: Flamefang Pitch
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Slot it below your other Tip of the Spear spenders, and in AoE wait until Wildfire Bomb has a full charge of cooldown reduction to absorb.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in any of the 5 sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; the guide lists it in every priority.

major_cooldowns.name: Potion of Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink it as Takedown comes up so the stat buff covers the burst, and use the second one inside the last 25 seconds of the fight.
major_cooldowns.id_note: CAST in 4/5 parses; the guide's opener timeline names Tempered Potion (431932) instead, which no sampled parse pressed.

major_cooldowns.name: Primal Rage
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep a Ferocity pet out and fire it when your group calls for Bloodlust.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Requires a Ferocity pet; not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

rule.description: Kill Command before Tip of the Spear caps
rule.action: Spend a stack on Wildfire Bomb, Boomstick or Raptor Strike between Kill Commands.

rule.description: Wildfire Bomb spends a Tip of the Spear stack
rule.action: Take a stack from Kill Command first, and throw it untipped only to stop a charge capping.

rule.description: Boomstick spends a Tip of the Spear stack
rule.action: Hold the channel until a Kill Command has handed you a stack to spend.

rule.description: Hunter's Mark stays up on your target
rule.action: Mark the boss before the pull and reapply it whenever you swap to a new priority target.
Pre-cast Wildfire Bomb one GCD before the pull, then send Takedown before you channel Boomstick.
